minper.description: Minimum number of days back of entries to keep in the uploaded archives database.

otherper.description: Number of days back of entries to keep for other upload methods (e.g., S3) when TTL is not explicitly configured.

BM_UPLOADED_ARCHIVES.description: Path to the file containing the database of uploaded archives.

BM_ARCHIVE_TTL.description: Time-to-live (in days) for archives — used as baseline retention period.

BM_UPLOAD_METHOD.description: Upload method used (e.g., scp, ssh-gpg, ftp, s3). Determines retention logic.

BM_UPLOAD_SSH_TTL.description: Time-to-live (in days) for SSH-based uploads (scp, ssh-gpg). Overrides archive TTL if set.

BM_UPLOAD_FTP_TTL.description: Time-to-live (in days) for FTP uploads. Overrides archive TTL if set.

BM_REPOSITORY_USER.description: User owning the backup repository directory and files.

BM_REPOSITORY_GROUP.description: Group owning the backup repository directory and files.

BM_REPOSITORY_CHMOD.description: Permission mode (octal) applied to repository files (e.g., uploaded archives database).

BM_REPOSITORY_ROOT.description: Root directory of the backup repository where archives are stored.
